_doc: TEMPLATE STORY SCENES. A scene binds a background image, a music track, and an entry dialogue node. Chapter/act/milestone fields feed the spoken Quest Recap and the debug chapter-warp menu — no story metadata is hardcoded in engine classes.

scenes.name: The Proving Grounds
scenes.ambientDescription: An ancient vaulted chamber where stone glyphs hum in resonance with spoken incantations.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You entered the proving grounds, learned to speak commands aloud, and tested your voice in trial combat.
scenes.defaultObjective: Speak with the chronicle, learn the mechanics, and run the combat trials.

scenes.name: The Echo Hall
scenes.ambientDescription: A vast hall of polished stone where every spoken word returns twice, testing the clarity of your intent.
scenes.milestoneSummary: You rested in the Echo Hall, then faced the Proving Guardian and conquered its phased assault.
scenes.defaultObjective: Rest to restore the party, then defeat the Proving Guardian.
